recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Pocket Kin Expedition**, a mobile-first browser game that preserves a classic turn-based 10x10 roll-and-move board race while expressing it as a bright creature-collector RPG route. The player leads a partner monster team against rival trainer squads. A scan roll advances the active team along 100 serpentine route steps. Evolution bursts carry teams upward, rival challenges push them backward, and the first team to reach Champion Grove wins. Use procedural canvas art for the board, animated meadow-route background layers, rounded elemental monster tokens, collection/codex HUD language, readable portrait controls, and compact feedback overlays. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: 1-8 participants, human first player, CPU auto-rolls, d6 movement, capped final tile, five upward shortcuts, six downward traps, current-turn HUD, options, win/finish modal, and restart flow.

User steering prompt: Pokemon creature-collector RPG. A Pokemon creature-collector RPG with elemental monsters, team building, turn-based battles, evolution, world exploration, rival energy, collectible obsession, and a bright adventurous coming-of-age tone with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source identity as implemented
The preserved source is a mobile browser Snakes-and-Ladders style board game named Sky Snakes. It uses a 10x10 serpentine board, 100 numbered tiles, random upward ladders, random downward snakes, one human player and CPU opponents, d6 rolling, animated token movement, current-turn HUD, options, audio toggles, win/finish modal, and restart/menu flow.

## Protected mechanics
- 10x10/100-tile board topology and serpentine tile coordinate mapping.
- 1-8 participants with player 0 as the human and CPU rivals auto-rolling.
- D6 roll animation and movement cap at tile 100.
- Five upward connections and six downward connections generated with the same start/end constraints.
- Turn order, movement interpolation, shortcut/trap resolution, win detection, options, restart, and menu semantics.

## Remix target
Pocket Kin Expedition reframes the board race as a bright creature-collector coming-of-age route. Ladders become evolution bursts; snakes become rival challenges; tokens become partner monsters; route progress becomes codex-worthy exploration.

## Safe transformation surfaces
HUD vocabulary, token rendering, board art, background, modal copy, audio mapping, feedback overlays, fonts, colors, and procedural motif language are safe to transform because they do not alter core movement, turn, scoring, or win semantics.
